snippet.title: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades 2 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming to the Meta Quest 3 and SteamVR!

https://vr.meta.me/s/1ZiXyovkm5EaUIh
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4632350

Shoot, loot, and scoot as a sentient hot dog in the sequel to Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades (H3VR), the award-winning, best-selling Immersive FPS.

Master an arsenal of the best guns in VR. Fight your way through an endless proc-gen megastructure. Chill out and plink on the range. 

Wonderful!

(Huge thanks to @DemoAkuro [https://demoakuro.com] for making the trailer!)
